build_grasp_generator: build a GraspGenerator instance with MpSim, MpSpace, IkHelper, and motion planning parameters for robot grasp planning
gen_target_from_ee_pos: generate a RobotTarget from a given end-effector 3D position using inverse kinematics and collision validation
gen_target_from_obj_idx: generate a RobotTarget by sampling grasp points around an object's bounding sphere in the simulation
gen_goal_state: generate feasible joint states for a desired end-effector target position using random search and IK solving
get_real_ee_pos: compute the actual end-effector position in world space from a given set of robot joint angles
